sources.snippet: The model download is approximately 1.5GB for the quantized E2B variant. First token appears in about 3-4 seconds on the Pi 5. That's not fast enough for real-time autocomplete, but it's absolutely fast enough for batch processing, local document analysis, and offline AI ...
